title: Example 137: a window start aligned by a mask on power-of-two windows and by the remainder elsewhere proved equal
description: Regression proof (B9) by the tool's own checker (--engine native) of Crosscut's Window#counted rewritten to align the start by nowNanos & -windowNanos when windowNanos is a power of two and by the remainder otherwise. Expected: verified on every input, 0.5 s, 10 paths, 17 solver calls, the one division left to the solver under the facts of every division and built in full once. JBMC did not finish the same harness within 60 s.
